opening.argument: The video presents a practical troubleshooting sequence for Netflix not working on a Panasonic television, beginning with a change to the TV’s DNS setting and continuing through Netflix app registration steps. The viewer is told to deactivate the account, then sign back into Netflix; if the app still does not load the account, the narration directs them to Netflix’s help domain. These are instructions for addressing connectivity and app-registration problems, not a financial offer or payment request. Although the steps involve signing back in, the described material does not solicit credentials. The observable sequence supports an instructional purpose without establishing any promised financial benefit or other transaction.

citations.quote: Panasonic - How to Troubleshoot Netflix Not Working
Step 1 Go to the Network menu of your TV and change the DNS setting to 8.8.8.8
Step 3. Follow the on-screen prompts to deactivate your account.
Once you've successfully deactivated your account, select Menber-Sign in and log back into your Netflix account.
If the Netflix app still doesn't load your account visit help.netflix.com for more help.
